title: One-Sample Probe
summary: Compare a sample mean with a known value using t.test(mu = ), and pull t, df, p and the CI out of the result.
hints: A test result is a list: `res$statistic`, `res$parameter` (the df), `res$p.value`, `res$conf.int`, `res$estimate`.
`unname()` strips the name R attaches ("t", "df"), so `t_val <- unname(res$statistic)`.
